channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dyson Daniels | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dyson Daniels from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitchell Robinson on Dyson Daniels
item.description:
Mitchell Robinson:Mitchell Robinson on his technical foul for stepping over Dyson Daniels in Game 2:

“It was a lot of shit that led up to that, but I ain’t gonna speak on it.”

Mitchell Robinson on Dyson Daniels, Apr 23, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Evan Mobley, Dyson Daniels
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Oh man, I think—put it in the bag. That’s what I think. Put it in the bag. Yours truly. That’s who I’m rocking with. Listen, I think Evan Mobley has had a great year. Dyson Daniels has had a great year. I think Zubac has had a great year. All those guys have had great years. I ain’t taking nothing away from them—and I see them on First-Team All-Defense. But I think DPOY should go to yours truly. I’ll take that.”

Draymond Green on Evan Mobley, Dyson Daniels, Apr 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Hawks coach Quin Snyder said Saturday.

“So, I don’t look at it as a positional thing where (we) talk about backup this. It’s the same way you look at a wing. Dyson (Daniels) is not Hunt’s (De’Andre Hunter) backup, Zacch’s (Zaccharie Risacher) not Dyson’s backup. Bogi’s (Bogdan Bogdanovic) not Zacch’s backup. Like you have players, and the most important thing is (how) the team functions. And that means, when I say functions, it’s successful.”

Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Willie Green on Dyson Daniels
item.description:
Willie Green on Dyson Daniels' left knee injury:

“He’s a tough kid and a tough young man. We just want a speedy recovery and see where we are and see if we can possibly get him back this season.”

Willie Green on Dyson Daniels, Feb 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Dyson Daniels
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Larry Nance Jr. on Dyson Daniels/#Pelicans:

“Dyson is everywhere. Defensively, he’s NBA-ready today, and offensively, he’s got confidence. Everybody on this roster right now can help us win NBA games, and I don’t know if there are two other teams in the league that can say that.”

Larry Nance Jr on Dyson Daniels, Oct 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
